description: Next.js product page as served before hydration: a loading skeleton with only the title and price as text, and the full product (SKU, images, variants, rating) inside script#__NEXT_DATA__ (application/json), along with recommendation products and a promo.

schema.name: string — product name
schema.sku: string — product SKU (style code, not a size variant)
schema.images: url[] — absolute URLs of the product's own images

notes: sku and images exist only in __NEXT_DATA__ (they would render after hydration; the engine must read embedded JSON without executing scripts). Image paths are relative ('/media/catalog/rtr2/black-side.jpg') and must be made absolute against the page URL. Decoys inside the same JSON: variant SKUs (RTR2-BLK-085 ...), recommendation products (Road Runner 4 $119.95, socks $24) and their images, promo 15% off, the /_next/image preload URLs.
